title: Ray diagram sheet
subject: Science
source: Seeded from science/y8 lesson 19 (Ray diagram sheet (portal worksheet, printable or on a drawing tablet))
intro: Lesson 19: Light on the move. To understand how light travels from luminous sources and how we see objects

picture.alt: Sunlight travelling in straight lines through clouds
picture.draw: Draw and label: Ray diagram sheet

questions.q: Light travels 150 000 000 km from the Sun at 300 000 km/s. Time?
questions.model: Time = distance ÷ speed. 150 000 000 ÷ 300 000 = 500 seconds. 500 ÷ 60 = 8.3 minutes. So about 8 minutes.

questions.q: Draw (describe) a ray diagram of seeing a book by a lamp.
questions.a: Ray from lamp to book, ray from book to eye, arrows pointing towards the eye.

questions.q: Core: Draw ray diagrams showing how you see: a lamp, a book lit by the lamp, and the Moon at night.
questions.a: Lamp: ray straight to eye; book: lamp to book to eye; Moon: Sun to Moon to eye; arrows show direction.
questions.model: Teacher draws the lamp first: a straight line from lamp to eye with an arrow pointing to the eye.

questions.q: Extend: Light from the Moon travels 384 000 km. How long does it take?
Stretch: Explain why we see lightning before we hear thunder.
questions.a: Light travels about a million times faster than sound in air.

questions.q: Big question: how long does sunlight take to reach us?
